questions.knowledge_point: Calculating a Cofactor in a NxN Matrix
questions.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${d}_{15}$, we remove the $1$st row and $5$th column: 

$$
D=[\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & 2 \\ 0 & 8 & -2 & 0 & ∗ \\ 6 & 2 & -9 & 4 & ∗ \\ 1 & 5 & 2 & 1 & ∗ \\ -1 & 4 & 3 & 10 & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

 
So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{15}=|\begin{aligned}0 & 8 & -2 & 0 \\ 6 & 2 & -9 & 4 \\ 1 & 5 & 2 & 1 \\ -1 & 4 & 3 & 10\end{aligned}|.
$$

Therefore, the cofactor of ${d}_{15}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{15} & =(-1)^{1+5}{M}_{15} \\  & ={M}_{15} \\  & =|\begin{aligned}0 & 8 & -2 & 0 \\ 6 & 2 & -9 & 4 \\ 1 & 5 & 2 & 1 \\ -1 & 4 & 3 & 10\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

questions.problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$D=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 4 & 0 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 6 & 5 & 3 & 0\end{aligned}].$
questions.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(D) & ={d}_{11}{C}_{11}+{d}_{12}{C}_{12}+{d}_{13}{C}_{13}+{d}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =0\cdot {C}_{11}+0\cdot {C}_{12}+0\cdot {C}_{13}+1\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & =1{C}_{14} \\  & =1\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & ∗ & 1 \\ 0 & 4 & 0 & ∗ \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & ∗ \\ 6 & 5 & 3 & ∗\end{aligned}| \\  & =1(-1)^{1+4}|\begin{aligned}0 & 4 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 6 & 5 & 3\end{aligned}| \\  & =-1(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 5 & 3\end{aligned}|-4\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ 6 & 3\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 6 & 5\end{aligned}|) \\  & =-(0-4(3\cdot 0-2\cdot 6)+0) \\  & =-48\end{aligned}
$$

questions.problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$H=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 3 & 0 & 8 \\ 1 & 2 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 1 & 2\end{aligned}].$
questions.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(H) & ={h}_{11}{C}_{11}+{h}_{12}{C}_{12}+{h}_{13}{C}_{13}+{h}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =0\cdot {C}_{11}+1\cdot {C}_{12}+0\cdot {C}_{13}+(-1)\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & ={C}_{12}-{C}_{14} \\  & =1\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & 1 & ∗ & ∗ \\ 0 & ∗ & 0 & 8 \\ 1 & ∗ & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & ∗ & 1 & 2\end{aligned}|+(-1)\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & ∗ & -1 \\ 0 & 3 & 0 & ∗ \\ 1 & 2 & 1 & ∗ \\ 0 & 2 & 1 & ∗\end{aligned}| \\  & =1\cdot (-1)^{1+2}|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 8 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 2\end{aligned}|+(-1)\cdot (-1)^{4+1}|\begin{aligned}0 & 3 & 0 \\ 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 & 1\end{aligned}| \\  & =-|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 8 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 2\end{aligned}|+|\begin{aligned}0 & 3 & 0 \\ 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 & 1\end{aligned}| \\  & =-(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}|-0\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}|+8\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}|)+(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 2 & 1\end{aligned}|-3\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}|) \\  & =8\cdot (-1)+(-3)\cdot 1 \\  & =-8-3 \\  & =-11\end{aligned}
$$

questions.problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$Z=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & 5 & 4 \\ 0 & 4 & 3 & 5\end{aligned}].$
questions.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(Z) & ={z}_{11}{C}_{11}+{z}_{12}{C}_{12}+{z}_{13}{C}_{13}+{z}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =1\cdot {C}_{11}+0\cdot {C}_{12}+(-1)\cdot {C}_{13}+0\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & ={C}_{11}-{C}_{13} \\  & =1\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & 0 & -2 & 0 \\ ∗ & -3 & 5 & 4 \\ ∗ & 4 & 3 & 5\end{aligned}|+(-1)\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & -1 & ∗ \\ 0 & 0 & ∗ & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & ∗ & 4 \\ 0 & 4 & ∗ & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =1\cdot (-1)^{1+1}|\begin{aligned}0 & -2 & 0 \\ -3 & 5 & 4 \\ 4 & 3 & 5\end{aligned}|+(-1)\cdot (-1)^{1+3}|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & 4 \\ 0 & 4 & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}0 & -2 & 0 \\ -3 & 5 & 4 \\ 4 & 3 & 5\end{aligned}|-|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & 4 \\ 0 & 4 & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}5 & 4 \\ 3 & 5\end{aligned}|-(-2)\cdot |\begin{aligned}-3 & 4 \\ 4 & 5\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}-3 & 5 \\ 4 & 3\end{aligned}|)-(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}-3 & 4 \\ 4 & 5\end{aligned}|-0\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 4 \\ 0 & 5\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & -3 \\ 0 & 4\end{aligned}|) \\  & =0+2\cdot |\begin{aligned}-3 & 4 \\ 4 & 5\end{aligned}|+0-(0-0+0) \\  & =2\cdot |\begin{aligned}-3 & 4 \\ 4 & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =2((-3)\cdot 5-4\cdot 4) \\  & =2\cdot (-31) \\  & =-62\end{aligned}
$$

questions.problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$U=[\begin{aligned}5 & -2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 3 & 6 & 0 & 1 \\ -3 & 2 & 5 & -4\end{aligned}].$
questions.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(U) & ={u}_{11}{C}_{11}+{u}_{12}{C}_{12}+{u}_{13}{C}_{13}+{u}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =5\cdot {C}_{11}+(-2)\cdot {C}_{12}+0\cdot {C}_{13}+0\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & =5{C}_{11}-2{C}_{12} \\  & =5\cdot |\begin{aligned}5 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & 0 & 1 & 0 \\ ∗ & 6 & 0 & 1 \\ ∗ & 2 & 5 & -4\end{aligned}|+(-2)\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & -2 & ∗ & ∗ \\ 0 & ∗ & 1 & 0 \\ 3 & ∗ & 0 & 1 \\ -3 & ∗ & 5 & -4\end{aligned}| \\  & =5\cdot (-1)^{1+1}|\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 0 \\ 6 & 0 & 1 \\ 2 & 5 & -4\end{aligned}|+(-2)\cdot (-1)^{1+2}|\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 0 \\ 3 & 0 & 1 \\ -3 & 5 & -4\end{aligned}| \\  & =5|\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 0 \\ 6 & 0 & 1 \\ 2 & 5 & -4\end{aligned}|+2|\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 0 \\ 3 & 0 & 1 \\ -3 & 5 & -4\end{aligned}| \\  & =5(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 5 & -4\end{aligned}|-1\cdot |\begin{aligned}6 & 1 \\ 2 & -4\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}6 & 0 \\ 2 & 5\end{aligned}|)+2(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 5 & -4\end{aligned}|-1\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 1 \\ -3 & -4\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 0 \\ -3 & 5\end{aligned}|) \\  & =5(0-(6\cdot (-4)-1\cdot 2)+0)+2(0-(3\cdot (-4)-1\cdot (-3))+0) \\  & =5\cdot 26+2\cdot 9 \\  & =130+18 \\  & =148\end{aligned}
$$

questions.problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$A=[\begin{aligned}0 & 8 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 3 & 1 & 6 & 2 \\ 1 & 0 & -1 & 2\end{aligned}]$
questions.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(A) & ={a}_{11}{C}_{11}+{a}_{12}{C}_{12}+{a}_{13}{C}_{13}+{a}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =0\cdot {C}_{11}+8\cdot {C}_{12}+0\cdot {C}_{13}+0\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & =8{C}_{12} \\  & =8\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & 8 & ∗ & ∗ \\ -1 & ∗ & 0 & 0 \\ 3 & ∗ & 6 & 2 \\ 1 & ∗ & -1 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =8(-1)^{1+2}|\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 0 \\ 3 & 6 & 2 \\ 1 & -1 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =-8((-1)\cdot |\begin{aligned}6 & 2 \\ -1 & 2\end{aligned}|-0\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 2 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 6 \\ 1 & -1\end{aligned}|) \\  & =8(6\cdot 2-(-1)\cdot 2)-0+0 \\  & =8\cdot 14 \\  & =112\end{aligned}
$$
